2607.25375.title: Inspect India Evals: An Open Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models in the Indian Linguistic and Cultural Context
2607.25375.paper_summary: India is a vast nation of over 1.4 billion people, varied by hundreds of diverse and locally specific traditions and cultures and 22 officially recognized languages. Large language models (LLMs) are now being deployed on a massive scale throughout the mainland as well as in remote villages. However, the common benchmarks - MMLU, BIG-Bench, and TruthfulQA are almost exclusively English- and Western-centric. They do not identify those safety, fairness, and accuracy failures unique to the Indian context. That is the gap Inspect India Evals seeks to fill. It is an open-source framework built on top of UK AISI's Inspect AI platform. It has six benchmarks: Multilingual MMLU across sixteen Indian languages, BharatBBQ (our adaptation of BBQ for Indian social bias), a safety evaluation for Digital Public Infrastructure, a multilingual safety test using harmful prompts in Indian languages, a multi-turn jailbreak resistance test, and an Indian cultural knowledge benchmark scored using LLM-as-judge rubrics. In this study, we tested five open-weight models ranging from 8B to 32B parameters. Sarvam-M 24B and Gemma 2 27B came out on top, both scoring 80% on the composite India Fairness Index, with Sarvam-M even beating larger 32B models on Indian cultural knowledge and DPI safety compliance. All models scored 100% refusal on Multilingual Safety, whereas DPI safety varied from 20% to 100%. The framework is public. It's built to work with the UK AISI registry. Anyone can reproduce or extend this work.
2607.25375.paper_summary_zh: 印度是一個擁有超過14億人口的廣大國家，擁有數百種多樣且地方特有的傳統和文化，以及22種官方認可的語言。大型語言模型（LLMs）現在在整個大陸以及偏遠村莊中被大規模部署。然而，常見的基準 - MMLU、BIG-Bench 和 TruthfulQA 幾乎完全以英語和西方為中心。它們無法識別在印度背景下獨特的安全性、公平性和準確性失敗。這正是 Inspect India Evals 希望填補的空白。這是一個基於英國 AISI 的 Inspect AI 平台構建的開源框架。它有六個基準：跨越十六種印度語言的多語言 MMLU、BharatBBQ（我們對 BBQ 的印度社會偏見的改編）、數位公共基礎設施的安全評估、使用印度語言的有害提示的多語言安全測試、一個多輪越獄抗性測試，以及一個使用 LLM 作為評判標準的印度文化知識基準。在這項研究中，我們測試了五個開放權重模型，參數範圍從 8B 到 32B。Sarvam-M 24B 和 Gemma 2 27B 輪流名列前茅，兩者在綜合印度公平指數上均得分 80%，而 Sarvam-M 在印度文化知識和 DPI 安全合規性上甚至超越了更大的 32B 模型。所有模型在多語言安全測試中均得分 100% 拒絕，而 DPI 安全性則在 20% 到 100% 之間變化。該框架是公開的。它旨在與英國 AISI 註冊處一起使用。任何人都可以重現或擴展這項工作。
